title.purpose: iOS .title2.bold() / Android headlineSmall bold for the poster contact name; native roles scale with the reader.

headline.purpose: iOS title3/headline/subheadline semibold and Android titleMedium/titleSmall/labelLarge semibold for Markdown headings.

body.purpose: iOS .body / Android bodyLarge for the reading path; plan items use iOS .callout / Android bodyLarge.

label.purpose: Native caption/footnote and Android label/bodySmall roles for time, receipts, and secondary detail; not a frozen CSS font size.

label-emphasis.purpose: Semibold plan headers, active tasks, contact names, and primary option labels, retaining their native text roles.

label-medium.purpose: iOS caption.medium stat pills and subheadline.medium thinking; Android labelMedium stat counts and medium thinking label.

mono.purpose: Native monospace for code and shell summaries; proportional prose retains monospaced digits only when it is measured data.

composer-android.purpose: The existing 17sp BasicTextField. The frontmatter px size is a portable preview export; native scaling remains in sp.

shadows.name: ios-jump-to-latest
shadows.purpose: The regular-material jump-to-latest capsule; a native blur radius, not a guessed CSS blur diameter.

shadows.name: android-chrome-capsule
shadows.purpose: Opaque surfaceContainerHigh capsules and round buttons; retain the platform-rendered shadow.

shadows.name: android-chrome-sheet

motion.name: conversation-spring-ios
motion.purpose: Appended-message settlement, plan progress, and reversible work disclosures.

motion.name: conversation-spring-android
motion.purpose: Compose arrival and plan progress; do not pretend its physical stiffness is a CSS easing curve.

motion.name: message-arrival
motion.value: opacity 0→1; y 10→0 incoming / 18→0 outgoing; scale 0.97→1; tail-corner anchor
motion.purpose: Only newly appended rows after the first rendered history, never initial load or paging. Units are pt/dp.

motion.name: reduced-motion-ios
motion.value: opacity/easeOut 200ms; no arrival translation or scale
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion alternative for the sampled conversation transitions.

motion.name: removed-animations-android
motion.value: snap(); static active arcs and roster rings
motion.purpose: Respect MotionDurationScale zero; arrivals and plan changes settle instantly.

motion.name: plan-check
motion.purpose: Completion change on a visible plan; initialized completed history does not replay the check.

motion.name: plan-active-arc
motion.purpose: The current plan item, static when animation is reduced/removed.

motion.name: thinking-shimmer
motion.purpose: A restrained moving ink highlight on the live thinking label; use a static label for reduced motion.

motion.name: android-step-reveal
motion.purpose: Stagger the expanded step trail with a bounded delay; snap with animations removed.

motion.name: roster-working-arc
motion.purpose: Slower identity-surrounding work motion; a full static ring when animation is disabled.

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Deep-blue send disc (32 logical units) inside an Android 48dp target. The inline SVG copies the app’s authored send vector; browser interaction states are preview-only.
components.css: .ds-send-target { width:48px; height:48px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:0; padding:0; border-radius:50%; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-send-disc { width:32px; height:32px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:50%; background:#2E6FDB; color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-send-disc svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-send-target:hover:not(:disabled) .ds-send-disc { filter:brightness(0.94); } .ds-send-target:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2E6FDB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-send-target:active:not(:disabled) .ds-send-disc { filter:brightness(0.88); } .ds-send-target:disabled { cursor:default; } .ds-send-target:disabled .ds-send-disc { background:color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 18%, transparent); color:GrayText; } .ds-send-target:dir(rtl) svg { transform:scaleX(-1); }

components.name: Composer Field
components.description: Android’s scalable 17sp draft, one-to-five-line growth, blue caret, and fixed 24dp corners. Canvas stands in for the OS-owned chrome material in this browser preview; no glass/elevation value is fabricated.
components.css: .ds-composer { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:6px; min-height:48px; border-radius:24px; background:Canvas; color:CanvasText; } .ds-composer-field { flex:1; min-width:0; min-height:1lh; max-height:5lh; field-sizing:content; resize:none; border:0; padding:11px 0 11px 14px; background:transparent; color:CanvasText; caret-color:#2E6FDB; font:400 17px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-composer-field:focus { outline:none; } .ds-composer:focus-within { outline:2px solid #2E6FDB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-composer-field::placeholder { color:GrayText; } .ds-composer-send { display:grid; place-items:center; width:48px; height:48px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:50%; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; } .ds-composer-send span { display:grid; place-items:center; width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:#2E6FDB; color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-composer-send svg { width:16px; height:16px; } .ds-composer-send:hover:not(:disabled) span { filter:brightness(0.94); } .ds-composer-send:active:not(:disabled) span { filter:brightness(0.88); } .ds-composer-send:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2E6FDB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-composer-send:disabled { cursor:default; } .ds-composer-send:disabled span { background:color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 18%, transparent); color:GrayText; } .ds-composer-send:dir(rtl) svg { transform:scaleX(-1); }

components.name: Conversation Navigation
components.description: A compact translation of native back, contact/thread, and computer furniture, not a new global navigation bar. Native mascot and OS material remain in the app; this self-contained snippet shows the control shapes on browser semantic Canvas.
components.css: .ds-chat-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:4px 12px; color:CanvasText; } .ds-chat-nav button { min-height:48px; border:0; border-radius:9999px; background:Canvas; color:CanvasText; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chat-nav-back { min-width:48px; padding:0 14px; } .ds-chat-nav-back-icon { transform:rotate(180deg); } .ds-chat-nav-computer { width:48px; padding:0; } .ds-chat-nav svg { width:20px; height:20px; vertical-align:middle; } .ds-chat-nav-name { flex:1; padding:0 14px; font:600 15px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-chat-nav-thread { margin-inline-start:6px; color:GrayText; font-weight:400; } .ds-chat-nav button:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 6%, Canvas); } .ds-chat-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2E6FDB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chat-nav button:active { background:color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 10%, Canvas); } .ds-chat-nav:dir(rtl) .ds-chat-nav-back-icon { transform:rotate(180deg) scaleX(-1); }

components.name: Live Plan Card

Plan2 of 5

components.css: .ds-plan { padding:14px; border-radius:20px; background:rgb(219.65 227.57 241.57); color:#000000; font:400 1em system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-plan header { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-plan header svg { width:19px; height:19px; color:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); } .ds-plan header strong { font-weight:600; } .ds-plan header>span { margin-inline-start:auto; color:GrayText; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-plan-progress { height:4px; margin-bottom:12px; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.06); overflow:hidden; } .ds-plan-progress>span { display:block; width:40%; height:100%; border-radius:9999px; background:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); } .ds-plan ul { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; } .ds-plan-item { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; } .ds-plan-marker { flex:none; width:20px; height:20px; margin-top:2px; border-radius:50%; } .ds-plan-item--done { color:GrayText; } .ds-plan-item--done>span:last-child { text-decoration:line-through; } .ds-plan-item--done .ds-plan-marker { display:grid; place-items:center; background:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-plan-item--done svg { width:13px; height:13px; } .ds-plan-item--active { font-weight:600; } .ds-plan-item--active svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); stroke-width:1.5; } .ds-plan-item--active circle { opacity:0.35; } .ds-plan-item--active path { stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; transform-origin:10px 10px; animation:ds-plan-arc 1s linear infinite; } .ds-plan-item--pending .ds-plan-marker { border:1.5px solid GrayText; width:17px; height:17px; } @keyframes ds-plan-arc { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-plan-item--active path { animation:none; } }

components.css: .ds-step-run { color:CanvasText; font:400 1em system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-step-run summary { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; cursor:pointer; list-style:none; color:GrayText; } .ds-step-run summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; } .ds-step-run-stack { display:flex; padding-inline-end:6px; } .ds-step-run-badge { display:grid; place-items:center; flex:none; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5 / 20%); color:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); } .ds-step-run-stack .ds-step-run-badge+.ds-step-run-badge { margin-inline-start:-6px; outline:1.5px solid Canvas; } .ds-step-run-badge svg { width:12px; height:12px; } .ds-step-run-chevron { width:16px; height:16px; margin-inline-start:auto; transform:rotate(90deg); } .ds-step-run[open] .ds-step-run-chevron { transform:rotate(-90deg); } .ds-step-run-trail { position:relative; padding-block:5px; } .ds-step-run-trail:before { content:""; position:absolute; inset-inline-start:10.5px; top:16px; bottom:16px; width:1px; background:color-mix(in srgb, CanvasText 20%, transparent); } .ds-step-run-item { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; padding-block:5px; } .ds-step-run-item small { display:block; margin-top:3px; color:GrayText; font-size:0.875em; } .ds-step-run-command { font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,monospace; } .ds-step-run summary:hover { color:rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); } .ds-step-run summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid rgb(41.25 95.25 172.5); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:12px; } .ds-step-run summary:active { opacity:0.8; }

narrative.overview:
A conversation belongs to the contact, not to an agent console. The mascot and its colour establish recognition; familiar speech bubbles and native system type carry the words. Deep Maus blue distinguishes the person's messages. The bot replies on a soft contact-coloured surface, with a contrast-resolved ink for links, checks, and progress. The result is personal, cozy, and familiar without dressing the transcript as a tool log.

Density is intentionally uneven: messages are closely grouped, separate turns have air, and work details live in quieter rows or deliberate disclosures. The live plan is the signature object: it stays in the reading lane while its progress changes. Depth belongs to floating chrome, not to every piece of conversation. iOS keeps system glass; Android uses opaque elevated Material surfaces rather than imitating that glass.
keyCharacteristics: Contact identity through the existing mascot and per-bot colour, including the actual speaker in rooms.
Solid, rounded speech bubbles with one soft tail at the end of a run.
Semantic native type and surfaces, with distinct iOS and Android material implementations.
A shared conversation-card family, restrained work receipts, and progress with readable numbers.
State-driven motion with reduced-motion alternatives, rather than entrances on loaded history.

rules.name: The Contact Owns the Ink Rule
rules.body: Resolve the bubble and its ink from the same speaker colour. Raw mascot colour identifies a contact; contrast-resolved ink carries links, step glyphs, checks, and progress.

rules.name: The Native Neutral Rule
rules.body: Preserve the platform's actual neutral and contrast policy instead of forcing identical light/dark swatches across iOS and Android.

rules.name: The Numbers Stay Still Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced digits/tabular-number features for progress and measured data, while keeping prose in the system proportional face.

rules.name: The Float the Furniture Rule
rules.body: Reserve glass or elevation for floating navigation, composer, and transient controls; conversation bubbles and plan cards remain solid and flat.

dos: **Do** resolve each reply's surface and ink from its speaker, keeping room chrome distinct from room speakers.
**Do** preserve the platform-specific tint computation, semantic text roles, all Android skins, and light/dark label selection.
**Do** keep one authored tail at the end of a text run and retain its drop, mirrored layout, and shared card family.
**Do** use tabular numerals for progress and measured data, and reserve monospace for actual code/commands.
**Do** keep work disclosures tap-accessible and retain state labels/icons alongside colour.
**Do** preserve native touch targets, text scaling, Back, selection, screen-reader labels, and reduced-motion alternatives.
**Do** animate live state changes and appended messages without replaying loaded or paginated history.
donts: **Don't** use raw mascot orange for small problem text on a light transcript or assume white labels/checks work on every dark-mode ink fill.
**Don't** flatten iOS glass and Android opaque elevated chrome into one faux-glass implementation.
**Don't** give every bubble/card a shadow, a glow halo, a thick coloured side border, or terminal-style log chrome.
**Don't** substitute generic avatars, emoji/glyph icons, or triangular pointers for the existing mascot, native icon system, and authored bubble tail.
**Don't** turn a growing composer into a tall capsule or shrink table text to avoid horizontal scrolling.
**Don't** promote illustrative browser previews, synthesized tonal ramps, or values from the provisional build spec into new native tokens.
